title: Opponent-Specific Plans: Should Rajasthan Royals Build a New XI for Every Match?
dek: Should Rajasthan Royals rebuild their eleven for every opponent? Head-to-head records show how much results really vary from one rival to the next.
excerpt: Rajasthan Royals' head-to-head win rates span a wide range across their opponents. Some of that is genuine match-up, some is the noise of small samples.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: One Eleven or Ten
body: Every opponent has a different shape: some bat deep, some rely on spin, some have a single destructive opener. The question is whether Rajasthan Royals should pick a different eleven for each, or keep a stable side and adjust tactics.
The head-to-head record is the starting point. RR have met {{ev:opp-most-opp}} most often, winning {{ev:opp-most-pct}} of {{ev:opp-most-n}} decided matches.

sections.heading: How Much Results Vary
body: Rajasthan Royals' best record, among opponents met at least six times, is against {{ev:opp-best-opp}} at {{ev:opp-best-pct}}; their weakest is against {{ev:opp-worst-opp}} at {{ev:opp-worst-pct}}.
The spread between those records is {{ev:opp-spread}} percentage points. Part of that spread is real, part is what any team would see by chance over a dozen or so matches per opponent.

sections.heading: Where Specific Plans Pay
body: Opponent-specific selection pays when an opponent has a structural weakness that one player in the squad exploits, such as a left-arm wrist spinner against a right-hand-heavy top order.
It does not pay when it unsettles a stable core. For RR, one or two match-up changes per game is a sensible ceiling.

sections.heading: Small Samples, Big Stories
body: Head-to-head records are built from few matches over many seasons, with different squads each time. A poor record against one rival can be history rather than a current weakness.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Stable Core, Targeted Changes
body: Rajasthan Royals should keep a stable core and make targeted changes where an opponent's structure creates a clear match-up.
Recent head-to-head results, weighted towards the last three seasons, are a better guide than the all-time record.
